source: Tables shipped with the Lords Mobile client (buildkind_new_MB, buildUP_NEW_MB, BuildRequestGroup), names from its string tables. Levels count the mana levels (25 + 5 per mana level, up to 55). time is the base duration in seconds. req_building: a building of that type must be at that level; req_research: a research at that level; req_quest: a step of the game's quests, not visible to the bot.
